name: Field
summary: Composition wrapper for a single form control. Stacks label + description + control shell + hint/error in one vertical group. The control shell owns the focus surface; slots (leading icon, trailing icon, addon) bond under that single ring.

label.description: Visible label. Always render unless aria-label is set on the input.

description.description: Description shown beneath the label, above the control.

error.description: Error message. Sets aria-invalid + role=alert. Mutually exclusive with hint.

hint.description: Hint message shown beneath the control.

optional.description: Render `(optional)` next to the label. NN/g preferred over the asterisk pattern.

required.description: Render the required asterisk + sets aria-required on the input.

trailingAddon.description: Trailing unit chip (lb / STD / %). Renders mono uppercase tracked.

children.description: Custom control. When present, replaces the built-in <input>. Consumer is responsible for the focus shell.

keyboard: Click — anywhere on the field shell focuses the inner control
rules: Label is associated to the control via htmlFor / id pair.
Hint and error IDs are concatenated into aria-describedby (space-separated) so AT users hear both.
Error sets role=alert + aria-invalid; announced as a polite live region by default.
Required adds aria-required + a visible asterisk; mutually exclusive with optional in practice.
Click anywhere on the shell focuses the inner control.

do: Use Field as the default composition for any text-entry control.
Pass leadingIcon / trailingIcon / trailingAddon for slot bonding — never wrap them in their own div.
Set hint to teach format (`12345 or 12345-6789`); set error only after submit / blur validation.
Use mono for codes and IDs.
dont: Don't render two Fields side-by-side without a label — always stack labels.
Don't paint borders on the inner control — the wrapper owns them.
Don't pass both `optional` and `required` — they contradict.
Don't use placeholder as the only label; placeholder vanishes on input.

changelog.note: Initial release. Single-shell focus pattern with slot bonding via :has(:focus-visible). Replaces the v0.5 split-ring composition that painted two halos.
